promotion_gates.reason: Parity MHC-II pooled exact-IC50 Spearman improved only +0.00636 versus required +0.05, and equal-study delta was -0.03648 with CI crossing zero.
Selected reference equal-study Spearman is 0.58501 versus NetMHCpan 4.2c at 0.68338; pooled values are 0.66971 versus 0.75845.
Selected reference equal-study Spearman is 0.57647 versus NetMHCIIpan 4.3e at 0.80702; pooled values are 0.49965 versus 0.77786.
Selected reference AUROC/AUPRC is 0.95203/0.95265 versus MHCflurry 0.94843/0.95428; the parity paired intervals cross zero, so this remains similarity rather than superiority.
Selected reference AUROC is 0.90576 versus MHCflurry 0.80567; parity's paired delta is +0.10114 with 95% CI [+0.07829,+0.14520], and parity-reference preservation interval crosses zero near zero.
Final evaluation preserves all four physical-affinity endpoint identities plus separate presentation and operational-processing outputs.
PRIME 2.1 ran through mhctools with the licensed MixMHCpred 3.0 backend in a two-peptide smoke test.
No newly disjoint T-cell accuracy cohort has been scored by the selected checkpoint or PRIME; the smoke is not an accuracy benchmark.
No untouched all-task TEST population has been scored by a frozen unified checkpoint.

blocked_claims: The selected reference checkpoint does not beat NetMHCpan on matched MHC-I development affinity.
The selected reference checkpoint remains substantially behind NetMHCIIpan on matched MHC-II development affinity.
Presentation is similar on three exposed studies but does not support a superiority claim.
No newly disjoint T-cell/PRIME accuracy comparison or independent all-task TEST exists.
state.headline: The retained assay-aware reference checkpoint preserves decisive processing performance, remains similar for presentation, and rejects a comparator-derived BA expansion that improved MHC-I but failed to improve MHC-II materially.
limitations: All headline metrics are development-only; no current cohort is relabeled as TEST.
Affinity equal-study estimates contain only two studies, and presentation/processing contain only three.
The experimental BA rows are comparator training archives and cannot establish independent superiority over those tools.
The selected reference checkpoint does not contain a promoted T-cell extension; historical T-cell results are context only.
NetMHC comparator versions are 4.2c/4.3e rather than newer patches, and MHCflurry lineage is only partially reconstructable.
qualified_claims: Both matched H100 fits completed 5,000 updates with passed coverage and zero TEST/locked access.
Operational-processing development AUROC is 0.90576 for the retained reference versus 0.80567 for MHCflurry; the near-identical parity arm has a paired +0.10114 interval wholly above zero.
Presentation AUROC/AUPRC is 0.95203/0.95265 for the retained reference versus 0.94843/0.95428 for MHCflurry, which supports similarity rather than superiority.
The parity arm improved MHC-I exact-IC50 Spearman but failed the preregistered MHC-II parent gate, so the reference checkpoint is retained.
The evaluator preserves assay-aware physical endpoints, and independent replay matches 110 estimates to maximum absolute delta 3.33e-16.
PRIME 2.1 through mhctools/MixMHCpred 3.0 is operational, but accuracy remains unevaluated.
